name: How do functional layout improvements differ from cosmetic renovations?

mainEntity.name: How do functional layout improvements differ from cosmetic renovations?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cosmetic renovations primarily focus on aesthetics, such as painting, new flooring, or updated fixtures, without changing the underlying structure or flow of the space. Functional layout improvements, however, involve structural changes like moving walls, reconfiguring rooms, or altering entryways to fundamentally improve how a space is used. While both can enhance a home, functional improvements address deeper issues of usability and efficiency.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cosmetic renovations are about appearance; functional layout improvements change how a space is used.
